images.caption: Figure 1:ReDiverse improves diversity in distilled image and video generators.For a fixed prompt, the student tends to repeat similar visual compositions, while ReDiverse produces broader variation: (a) dogs appear at different viewing distances and poses; (b) backpacks in various styles; and (c–d) videos show diverse environments, viewpoints, and styles. Each image grid shows samples from different seeds; each video row corresponds to one seed, with time progressing from left to right.
